host: Apple M4 / macOS; Vulkan uses MoltenVK
scope: PT preview opaque instance batching and clean preview reuse; P2-E high-resolution interactive acceptance incomplete
limitations: one process per scene/backend; optimized three cycles vs baseline one cycle, driver cache / host load uncontrolled; observations, not statistical throughput speedups
hidden 64x64 surface, 32x18 film, 4 spp / depth 8; Raster effects and denoise disabled; no input-to-photon or high-resolution convergence measurement
baseline uses same executable with --no-raster-batching --raster-during-preparation; clean preview copies / new telemetry remain enabled
opaque groups may reorder equal-depth surfaces; transparent/generated/SSS/projective draws are barriers; default ordinary Raster snapshots do not enable batching
geometry / triangle count unchanged; no frustum culling; instanced TAA uses conservative reactive marking, no per-instance previous poses
pose block limit 4096, all stable-ID chunks cached; batch leases and two clean RGBA8 previews are outside PT cache retention budgets but included in GPU/native peaks
last Raster packet counts exclude procedural oceans rendered separately; per-operation Raster frame deltas may include an already running prior packet
full assets required for startup ready; explicit initial Raster screenshot readback measured separately and excluded from continuous frame gaps
process RSS includes retained reference snapshots and optional fresh verification; package/fixed lighting drives PT only; no Raster/PT appearance parity claim
main process Metal instrumentation disabled; Khronos validation layer unavailable; final Vulkan native test 28.35s, an earlier driver/load-uncontrolled iteration took 101.93s
